verify_email.subject: Confirm your email address on MCPlain
verify_email.body:
Hello,

To confirm your email address on MCPlain, open this link:
{link}

The link works for one hour. Once it is confirmed, you are signed in.

You did not create an account? Ignore this message: nothing will happen.

MCPlain

reset_password.subject: Choose a new password on MCPlain
reset_password.body:
Hello,

Someone asked to change the password of your MCPlain account. To choose a new one, open this link:
{link}

The link works for one hour.

You did not ask for it? Ignore this message: your password stays the same.

MCPlain

admin_alert.subject: MCPlain: admin alert {code}
admin_alert.body:
Hello,

MCPlain recorded the alert {code} {count} time(s).
First one: {first} (UTC)
Last one: {last} (UTC)

The details are in the table ai_admin_alerts. You get at most one mail per alert code every 24 hours.

MCPlain
